fix(camellia): tighten version update mode handling

Summary:
- hide the version tip frequency selector unless the update mode is TIP
- omit tip_frequency from version saves for FORCE and CHECK modes
- show a concrete required-field toast before aborting invalid saves

Rationale:
- keep the version form aligned with the update mode semantics
- avoid sending irrelevant frequency data for non-TIP releases
- make save failures actionable instead of silently returning

Tests:
- cd theaceae && pnpm run check:camellia
